title: SIPP care and work constraints carry different universes and uncertainty
source_unit: SIPP person record by reference month using final person and Fay-BRR replicate weights

observations.period: 2024 reference year in the 2025 SIPP public-use file

denominator.unit: positive-final-person-weight selected person-record/month rows; 379,215 rows read

paid_for_childcare.unit: percent among 24,549 valid person-record/month records in the child-care-use universe

received_childcare_payment_assistance.unit: percent among 24,549 valid person-record/month records in the child-care-use universe

childcare_prevented_work_or_more_work.unit: percent among 31,788 valid person-record/month records in the reference-parent child universe

reported_time_lost_from_work_due_to_chil.unit: percent among 1,119 valid records conditional on reported child-care work prevention

observations.method: Care and work fields were screened with their official status flags (APAY, APAYHELP, AWORKMORE, ATIMELOST) and the released conditional universes. Full estimates use WPFINWGT; 240 replicate estimates use REPWGT1–REPWGT240 and Census Fay-BRR variance with G=240 and perturbation factor 0.5.
observations.uncertainty: Fay-BRR standard errors and approximate 95% intervals are reported. The time-lost measure is conditional on reported work prevention and has a small valid record count; nonresponse, recall, and reference-period uncertainty remain.
observations.subgroup: Reference-parent child-care-use universe for payment and assistance; reference-parent child universe for work prevention; conditional work-prevention universe for time lost.
observations.counterinterpretation: Payment, assistance, work prevention, and time lost are distinct questions and do not form a causal sequence. They do not identify a dated care event, provider shortage, employer decision, schedule control, paid/unpaid substitution, health outcome, trust change, or political action.

related_sources.claim: Official child-care field labels, status flags, and universes.

boundary: This is a person-weighted, design-based descriptive layer. It does not establish household prevalence, causal care or work effects, household time substitution, remedy, recovery, trust, political action, or a complete material-to-time-to-care chain.
